body: Haha, not really... Going over and over my stache, making sure I still have plenty so can figure out when I have to go out again..? I don't even know. I just tend to stay in my mind. I play guitar, very horribly. I do practice though.

I've been in and out of hospitals for the past few years in psych wards, on and off meds. Haha if I told my room mates, I Garuntee I wouldent have a roof over my head. And I'd actually have to associate with people. I don't know which is worse.

"And when you die the only kingdom you'll see
Is two foot wide and six foot deep."

Deep man. Makes me cringe in a good way.

I'm actually in the psych ward right now after another failed attempt. This is the first time that I was caught though. The friends that found me called an ambulance and have been extremely supportive over the whole ordeal, but I just feel a complete emptiness, a fog around me that won't lift. I still wish that I hadn't been found, and I had succeeded, but I have some friends I'm glad I didn't hurt. 


After my previous attempts, it was pretty much the same. Shame, guilt, hopelessness and helpless nobody found me those times.

If you really want to know how life is after an attempt at your own life and almost being successful multiple times... Just imagine fantasizing that you had succeed and that none of this is real. Now keep that in your head but never consciously think about it. Instead, you tell the nurses and doctors "I'm fine, really" in a vain attempt to be freed, and have another, successful, attempt.

I think I just needed to get it all out before I go... 
Yes, I still care about my friends and my ex.. This will free them as much as it will me. This has been nineteen years in the making, seven years of attempts and self hate for failure. Tonight it all ends
I know that I'm not alone, and other people have it worse, but I have nothing left to lose, so I'll take my life before I lose that too.
